title: Beatrix and the Promise
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Wren Eastwick, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
